hardware.engine_parallelism: one direct engine process, one OpenMP thread; no GPU requested
hardware.timing_interpretation: Measured on this executing host, not a benchmark of the project owner's computer

scientific_limits: One ordered repeated-motif cell, not an identified liquid, crystal or amorphous polymer
Refinements change a truncated Hamiltonian or finite Ewald approximation, not an exact-model error bound
Initial-geometry numerical diagnostics are not transferable to an evolved final state without a fresh audit
Molecules, refinement settings and trajectory fragments are not independent prepared cells
Short integration probes cannot certify equilibrium or bulk density
public_record_policy: Retain source geometry/recipe, one common system.data, every stage input/log/summary, only finest refined singlepoint force frame, final continuation checkpoint frame, and one full continued-chain static dataset. Duplicated initial/prepared per-chain rows, full assignment, other raw frames/readbacks and native binaries are hash-only and regenerable with this script.

system.density_role: requested geometric mass/volume, not a prediction
system.construction: one ordered repeated molecular motif cell

independent_motif_contact_reference.method: 26 neighboring motif offsets plus coordinate-span lower bound for all farther offsets

initial_chain_structure.orientation_vector_definition: unit vector between terminal backbone carbons, apolar under endpoint reversal
initial_chain_structure.orientation_weighting: equal weight per molecule; no atom-count or mass weighting of chain axes
initial_chain_structure.dimension_weighting: all-atom molar masses and carbon-only molar masses; equal-chain means

omitted_fields.interpretation: Repeated static chain rows omitted here; full continued structure has a separate public JSON and earlier rows can be regenerated
